reviews.title: Choose another airline
reviews.text: Used this airline a few times going London to Dubai or vice versa because it was a little cheaper than other airlines. The online check-in never works. Tried iphone/laptop/android and have never been able to check in for one of these flights. Then join a large queue (and arrive to airport early) unnecessarily as I don't take bags just to get a boarding pass. Not worth the difference in price. Go for BA/Emirates for better flight (and for the tech to actually work)
reviews.author: Explorer544348

reviews.title: DO NOT GIVE YOUR MONEY TO THIS AIRLINE. THEY WILL REFUSE COMPENSATION.
reviews.text: Absolutely awful airline, with even worst customer service. We arrived in Melbourne on 28th Feb 2023, only to find that my luggage was missing. I got it back after 2 MONTHS and had to spend all my savings on new clothes and medication. The journey to getting it back was absolutely appaling. My emails and calls were being ignored to the point where I was trying to contact them every day. I ended up going through Facebook messenger. They finally got back to me saying they have found my suitcase and will contact me when it is on the way. 2 days later and the WRONG suitcase arrived with no indication it was on the way, AFTER I had asked them to check the contents inside before the sent it. So then I ended up with some poor woman's suitcase in my garage. Fast foward another month, and my mother all the way back in England was also trying to contact them as we were being IGNORED!! FINALLY my suitcase turned up, not thanks to Royal Brunei, but to the luggage company in London/Melbourne (Menzies I believe). I have been trying to contact Royal Brunei for a further 3 weeks now about the compensation they owe me (they should pay me a certain amount for each day I was without my case and then some!!) STILL NO LUCK and yet again being ignored after resorting to contacting them about 4 times a week. They clearly do not want to take responsibility for the amount of financial and mental stress they have caused me, yet alone pay me the compensation I deserve. They are withholding my money and it's disgusting and unethical. I have never known such useless and disgraceful customer service. Please fly with another airline!!
reviews.author: Abbie S

reviews.title: DO NOT SPEND YOUR MONEY WITH THIS AIRLINE.
reviews.text: I've never left a review of anything in my life, If I have a bad experience I just don't use something again. HOWEVER after flying with Royal Brunei you realise how much of a useless money hungry neglectful business they are. For context, me and my partner flew from London to Melbourne with them. On arrival at baggage claim, after 3 hours of waiting my partners luggage didn't turn up. We were told by the airline we would recieve compensation and her bag shortly. A whole month later her bag was still lost and with no update as to where it was, they stopped responding to emails and calls. We did recieve the luggage two weeks later, however no compensation and no sign of it. We spent in total about £2000 on our flights and have recieved NO customer service. Just don't. They suck
reviews.author: Jack

reviews.title: Worst food and outdated plane.
reviews.text: We flew from dubai to london, it was very smooth until we got our food, the first meal was pizza it contained sand in it, when the next meal came the crew denied veg meal for our daughter despite pre ordering but we managed to get one after another crew got involved.
reviews.author: A J

reviews.title: The worst experience ever for a frequent flyer!
reviews.text: My first flight was delayed by 14 hours, then second flight was delayed 5 hours then brought forward again to 2 hours after the original flight making it a nightmare to get the the airport. The airline lost both my bags, one has fortunately showed up but the other is still missing. I am an expat so am frequently flying with many different airlines and never in my life have I experience such an awful service. I would stay well away even if it’s a cheaper flight! Definitely not worth the stress I have been through in the last 2 weeks.
reviews.author: Phillippa C

reviews.title: If you're doing some research on Royal Brunei before you go ahead and book your budget ticket, PLEASE READ THIS FIRST.
reviews.text: I am currently sat in Muscat international airport (Oman). My flight however is from London Heathrow, stopping at Brunei and then Manila. I departed at 17.15pm in London on the 2nd of April and I am typing this on the 4th of April at around 7am local time in Oman. I was supposed to land in Manila at around 9pm on the 3rd... So first class experience started with the online check-in service which did not work at all and would not let me do it after several attempts. When me and my partner checked in at the airport, the girl and the desk sat us both apart so we had an 8 hour trip to Dubai sitting separately. This is forgivable but I am including this as it gets so much worse. We landed in Dubai and the flight was fine, no complaints. When I originally booked this ticket, it was sold to me as a refuel in Dubai (so you remain on the plane) and then a change over in Brunei. So 2 stops but quick turnovers and only one airport to go through security. However when we got to Dubai, the captain announced we still had to get off to go through security to then come straight back onto the exact same plane and same seat. Ok? Once this was done, we were told that there was going to be a delay of around 20 minutes due to a 'technical' problem. This 20 minutes turned into 2 hours. What was happening was the plane would taxi onto the runway and then lose all power, so incredibly reassuring before reaching 40k ft at 500mph. Both times this happened, they parked the plane back up and then an engineer would investigate, he would walk into the cockpit and press the reset button. He did it twice so he had a busy day. We eventually took off but to then to my absolute amazement, around 25 minutes into the flight the captain announced we would be turning back around and landing immediately. So due to the fact we were having issues departing, me and my partner spent the next 30 minutes thinking it may be our last (can't beat those holiday feels). However the captain reassured us that everything was under control, it was just the left engine had failed, so no biggy. This is where the story gets incredible. We land at muscat around an hour after taking off from Dubai and are welcomed with around 7 fire engines, therefore the communication from the captain to the ground would have only been a subtle and in control mayday. We parked up on the runway, where we remain for around 90 minutes which the crew took this opportunity to run the breakfast service. Once this had been done, we finally get off and get shuttle busses to the airport. This was around 8/9am on the 3rd of April 2023. THIS WOULD BE THE LAST TIME ANY PASSENGER ON THAT FLIGHT WOULD SEE OR HEAR FROM ANYONE IN A ROYAL BRUNEI UNIFORM. A passenger who is in the british army but lives in Brunei had done the same trip the weekend before with Royal Brunei. He was in complete disbelief because he had a 13 hour delay that weekend with that exact plane.. BECAUSE OF THE LEFT ENGINE. And a week later, Royal Brunei are risking hundreds of lives on a long haul flight because it is clearly a known problem but clearly profit trumps children. From hear, we are hearded into a corner of the airport and kept for a total of 16+ hours. 1 6. Every passenger had missed their connecting flight (Brunei, Jakarta, manila and Melbourne) so we were stranded with no information. Royal Brunei had dropped us off and then abandoned their passengers with an airport team that had no chance to prepare and an airline that was unwilling to even pick up the phone. We waited, and we waiting and we waited for something, anything of their plans to resolve this issue but there was nothing. I have eventually been transferred to Oman airlines which I have had to wait over 24 hours for from my original Dubai departure time. However, 50% of the passengers are still stuck in a hotel (which took 12+ hours to be finally agreed to be given to them) as there are no flights to Melbourne. They put boxes of stale sandwiches and biscuits in the corner
reviews.author: Will T

reviews.title: DO NOT TRAVEL TO  AUSTRALIA FROM UK WITH THIS AIRLINE!
reviews.text: I am travelling to Australia with my wife, and my two children. We fly regularly long haul to Australia, Malaysia, USA and as such we are all accustomed to long haul flights. We purposely pick flights with short stop overs and ensure the days we travel allow for sleep eg travel afternoon or evening rather than early morning. We picked Royal Brunei as the flights were good take off times, short stopovers and on the correct dates of travel. My wife and I are now deeply upset that we have taken time off work that we can not change Royal Brunei have changed the flights. Summary: 1) They have cancelled our outgoing flight which was 1 stop from London to Melbourne. The new flight is two stops from London to Melbourne but both stops are short and the take off time is afternoon still, so not too bad. 2) They have cancelled part of our return flight - from Brunei to London and the alternative flight no longer connects with the flight from Melbourne. 3) They have put us on a flight from Melbourne to brunei more than a day earlier - approx 32 hours earlier. 4) They have taken us off the flight from Brunei to London on the day I booked and put me on a flight a day earlier and refuse to change this. 5) The original flight was 1 stop return from Melbourne to london on the dates we required and with a short stop over. we now are have stop overs over 10 hours in total and are flying home over a day earlier than we booked. 6) instead of an afternoon flight the new flight is now early morning (airport arrival required at 3am!!) 7) They refuse to give us a day stop over in brunei and put us on the original flight from brunei to london ie fly a day earlier from Mebourne to Brunei and then the original flight from Brunei to London. I would pay for a hotel for the night, they refused. 8) They refused to allow cancellation of the flights without a fee, which we can not afford and would lose our holiday entitlement from work. 9) I tried to compromise and asked for somewhere to sit/shower on the long stop over in Brunei. They refuse to give us access to a shower in Brunei airport eg day room or airline lounge access. 10) When I said I want to complaint they responded saying they a customer focused airline and if I want to take this further they will respond in 8 weeks time - i fly in 2 days! Travel insurance said that I am not covered as the airline has not delayed or put back the flight. The airline has brought forward the flight by 32 hours and this is not a delay. DO NOT BOOK WITH THIS AIRLINE IF YOU HAVE ANY STOP OVERS IN BRUNEI. THEY CAN CHANGE THE FLIGHTS TO EARLIER ONES ARE YOU HAVE NO CHOICE!!
reviews.author: si b

reviews.title: Thank you!
reviews.text: I would like to thank Dk. ASYAHDATUL A3100 (SENIOR) and SITI NYRUL HAZIYANA AU677 and DK. NAQIAH A4671 for taking especially good care of me . I had a very bad anxiety on the flight to BRUNEI. THEY took Exceptionally good care of me . THANK YOU SO MUCH! KEEP UP THE GOOD WORK! I would definitely fly with Royal Brunei Airline's again.
reviews.author: Irene Y

reviews.title: Scam company, don't use it!
reviews.text: They can change your flight to anytime any date and ask you to pay extra AU$200 for a refund if the change doesn't fit you! I have brought the flight from Melbourne to Tokyo with transition in Brunei.I was told the flight time was being changed from 1200 to 0600 on 18/5. However as I live in Tasmania, and paid for the non refundable ticket from Tasmania to Melbourne for the flight departure at 0855 .I could not get the flight connected and even if I book a new flight from Tasmania,the only possible flight I could book would be the flight arriving at 2200 on 17/5. That means I have to stay for extra 8 hrs while waiting for the flight and need to wait for extra 6hrs while waiting for the transition,in total 14 extra hrs of waiting time. As the change is causing my lost to rebook a new flight and leading to a further longer waiting time, I am hoping to get a refund without any extra fee charged. They just simply refused,saying that I am not booking the domestic flight and international flight together. Their option to me is either I have to pay AU$200 for the refund or they can change my resheduled flight from18/5 0600 to 20/5 1200.But it is them changing my flight time without my permission, not me.And now they are refusing my full refund while not providing the service I paid for!
reviews.author: Ming C

reviews.title: If going to australia from UK consider Royal Brunei
reviews.text: I recently visited Melbourne travelling outbound on the 19th Feb inbound 7th March 2023. Originally having been priced out of the trip by all other airlines. Online I came across an airline that appears to get no advertising in the UK. So after constant searching you come across Royal Bruneii who appear to offer a very reasonable price that the average Joe can afford. So you visit the the Web page. WHAT You find is that the price advertised is legitimate. So what can I say. VERY IMPRESSED. Economy Class we paid £1080 return including the cost of the seat booking reservation. The inflight food is very good and in my opinion is better than some of the bigger airlines that I have flown with. For economy class the seat pitch is awesome with plenty of leg room. The one downside to the flight is that being a Muslim airline they do not serve alcohol on the flight but your are allowed to bring your own on board but this must be consumed by the time you get To Bandar Seri Begwan (outbound your 2nd stopover inbound 1st stopover). Anyway waffle over. ROYAL BRUNEI airlines. PRICE - Very Affordable. FOOD - Very Good. LEG ROOM - Very Good PUNCTUALITY -My experience - On time. INFLIGHT HOSPITALITY - Cabin crew very good. INFLGHT ENTERTAINMENT - As good as any other. My overall Rating has to be 10/10 and I would happily recommend and again fly with Royal Brunei. Phil Bollington
reviews.author: Phil B

reviews.title: RBA prefers to beleive a flawed IT system rather than passengers

Was told that the IT system showed that my reservation was not cancelled but that (24 hours before planned departure) I had chosen to purchase a higher cost economy ticket- and somehow had decided to voluntarily pay a $100 penalty

reviews.author: david w

reviews.title: Don’t trust this airline
reviews.text: Royal brunei Over the last 8 years me and my wife have routinely flown to Melbourne Australia with Royale Brunei and have never had a problem. This all changed on our first trip with them after Covid. We booked a January 2023 return flight to Melbourne with Royale Brunei back in June 2022 for my wife and 2 children. With one of our children being 7 months old and the other 2 years we booked with Royale Brunei as they offered one of the lowest flights times, around 22 hours. Booking this far in advanced also meant we could secure bassinet seats for our baby. In mid November 2022 I received a SMS message stating one of my flights had changed and I was to log into the website for further information. After checking the booking, the flight duration had increased by around 7 hours bringing the total flight time to around 28 hours there and back. After further investigation it appear the airline had suddenly made the decision to stop at Dubai on our flights between London and Brunei. On top of that, our bassinet seats had been wiped out of the booking for the outbound London > Dubai > Brunei leg of the flight. The online seat selector was now showing these seats as being blocked out and unselectable. At this point we decided to give their London office a call to found out what was going on. Little did we know this was a whole other issue in itself. You just couldn’t get through to anyone. When calling it would be pot luck whether you would get a pre recorded voice mail system asking to leave a message or you would join a call queuing system. Once in the call system you would then be randomly cut off and have to start again, sometimes this would happen after waiting for more than an hour. Luckily I was working from home as was able to persist and eventually get through. Oh and don’t forget this intentional airlines london office closed for lunch between 1 and 2 so make sure not to calm around then. For the multiple times I did eventually get through I only spoke to the same person. It felt like she was the only person working for the airlines London office. While waiting to speak to someone, I looked online to see if anyone else was having the same issues with their flights and it appeared all the London to Melbourne routes over winter 2022/2023 had been made to stop at Dubai. Some other people weren’t as luckily as us due to flying out on a different day they had 12 our stop overs in Brunei instead. Potentially disrupting their whole trip. Once I did speak to the nice lady from their london office, I was told there was no other quicker flight available now so I could either move the flights to a different date or cancel for a full refund that would take up to 8 weeks to arrive. Being tao close to when we were actually flying, trying to book the same flight with another airline was coming in at nearly 3 times the cost. When querying about the bassinet seats being removed, the representative didn’t know why and she would have to send a email to head office. After about 2 weeks of constant chasing and sitting on the phone , it was confirmed that someone else had now booked our seats and no other bassinet seats were available. It was eventually explained to me that when the Dubai stop was added at some random point late 2022, all the pre selected seats were removed. Someone else has then booked them and there was nothing they could do even when we were flying with a 7 month old. After complaining the only thing they could offer us was different bassinet seats for the London to Dubai leg of the trip. Due to the London > Dubai > Brunei still being under one “flight” our normal seats still showed on the website. We were however assured the checkin team and flight crew knew about our updated seats and everything would be ok!.. As you can imagine, we got to the check in desk and no one knew anything and we were told no bassinet seats were available for any leg of the trip. When eventually on the flight it was great to see these seats being u

reviews.title: Excellent airline
reviews.text: I've flown Royal Brunei a number of times on the punishing Melbourne to London flight. It rates very highly on all the things that count: comfort, cleanliness, leg room, reliability & service. It is also well priced. The zero alcohol policy also lowers the nuisance risk. 5 stars!
reviews.author: Grant P

reviews.title: Thank you for the kindness
reviews.text: I want to thank the whole off Royal Brunei ground crew, both in KLIA & Bandar Seri Begawan. That despite being unable to board due to an unforeseen circumstances on my part, the kindness and assistance given by the crew has been like a glass of cold water in the middle of the desert. I cannot thank you enough. All the best to Royal Brunei. Keep up the good work.
reviews.author: Resni

reviews.title: The flights you buy is not what they will fly
reviews.text: I purchased London to Melbourne return flights in July 2022 for Christmas, a great flight option at 22 hours via Brunei (with a 2 hour layover in Brunei) each way. Then in November, I coincidentally was looking at Skyscanner for my dates, and noticed Royal Brunei were advertising at 32 hour flight, so I checked my emails, nothing, so checked the Royal Brunei site logging into ‘access my booking’, and low and behold, my 22 hour flight each way had become 32 hours to Melbourne (with a technical stop in Dubai and a 7 hour layover in Brunei), and my return flight was 50 hours (with a 28 hour layover in Brunei and technical stop in Dubai). Of course I called them straight away, and the best they could manage was getting me flights to be 32 hours each way. I made the decision to book with a superior airline at a higher cost (what I wish I did at the start in July) and cancel the Royal Brunei flights. Royal Brunei cancelled my booking on the 2nd November 2022 and confirmed the refund process had started with an estimated date of 4 - 6 weeks (early - mid December). Here we are on 20th January with no refund, and I have been chasing Royal Brunei weekly without a single response since 28th December. I cannot recommend to people anymore to just spend the extra money for a higher ranked airline, because whatever you think you are saving in money, you will lose in time and stress.
reviews.author: Nicholas B

reviews.title: Flight Changes constantly
reviews.text: I had booked flights for my children from London to Australia - every single flight I booked (5 people at different dates) was changed to less convenient times than we booked. The final one of these has now been changed to leaving 2 days later than when we booked meaning that my son will have 2 days taken from his 2 weeks holiday in Australia. I would not book with this airline ever again and would advise any people who know me not to touch them with a bargepole.
reviews.author: Stewart H

reviews.title: Travel Disaster via Royal Brunei
reviews.text: i who took your flight from Thai => Brunei => Heathrow. My airline booking reference no is 13J7RF. You must wonder why you receive this email because I've never had such an unpleasant flying experience as this time via Royal Brunei Airline. First, I found my 2nd flight from Brunei to Heathrow UK being changed from 00:40 to 22:50 on Jan 1 during checking in online via my cell phone 3 hours before the onboard time. When I double-checked with the check-in counter, they told me they'd never changed my flight until I showed them my itinerary. However, they couldn't provide me with any support and suggested I consulted the Royal Brunei staff after I arrived at the Brunei Airport. Then I was relieved. However, my heart sank again when your staff told me my luggage would not come along with me on the same flight while I checked in again at the Brunei airport the next day to take a 22:50 flight back to the UK. They said my luggage will be delivered to my home on Jan 4 or Jan 5 subject to its arrival. Are you kidding me? My life depends on medicine but your airline didn't take it seriously. I really didn't know how come your Airline can still survive without honesty. How can people trust your airline again with such an irresponsible attitude? Although your ground staff helped me to transfer my luggage to Singapore Airlines in order to let me get my checked luggage on Jan 2. However, I was informed by the ground staff that my checked luggage will only be at Heathrow Airport on Jan 3 when I arrived at the airport this morning (Jan 2). Also, that meant I have to stay at the hotel for a day to get my checked luggage the next day. Since your Airline changed my flight 22 hours later before I checked in and left my checked luggage behind let me wait for another day in London. Especially since no auto re-fund option is triggered/offered at the time of flight change. You are a SHAME to Brunei as its national carrier RBA. Be better!

reviews.title: Terrible experience of uncertainity of travel from booking to check-in and completing journey.
reviews.text: Worst ever airline I have ever flown and I have lost 3 valuable days of my much saught afer trip to Australia due to a blunder of the airline and their compurter system. There is no one to speak to from the airline at the airport and their office in London is useless with no one answering the phone during their office hours even (works from 9-5 only) . No agent at airport and passengers are left with no advice or information/update whatsoever. Me and my family endured 3 miserable days at airport having lost flight and money spent on another connection flight from Melbourne. Messages sent to airline remain unanswered todate. I would not recommend anyone to book a flight with this airline and risk their journey. In flight service with some legs, had only two options of food after less than half the flight served and air hosts become arrogant and rude when inquired.

reviews.title: decent airline - great stopover
reviews.text: Clean cabin, friendly cabin crew, decent in-flight entertainment, good food (especially the croissants for breakfast). Even better than the flight was the opportunity to spend the night in the delightfully serene country of Brunei. Would definitely travel this way again.
reviews.author: smalldog257

reviews.title: baggage delay is too long!
reviews.text: It’s been almost 5 DAYS! No updates were our baggages whereabouts. Doesn’t answer our call. Make false promises, told us that our bags will come the next day. BUT WHERE? Such a disappointment for an “world’s leading cabin crew”!! I’m so pissed because I have my precious pillow in that luggage they left in Bangkok!
reviews.author: Bella

reviews.title: Good flights
reviews.text: Travelled 3 flights going from Heathrow to Melbourne. Each stage had a flight time of around 7 hours. Initially the flight was from Heathrow to Bendar, which would have been really long, but we refuelled at Dubai. Dreamliner 787 so it was a large plane, very comfortable. We were around an hour late from Heathrow but still seemed to land at Melbourne on time. Check in at Heathrow was a test of endurance but it was Christmas Day and very busy. Cabin crew were excellent, very helpful and cheerful. My only suggestion to Royal Brunei would be to sell bottles of water/pop etc on the plane. The little cups of water that come with the meals are not enough on a long flight. You can also have tea/coffee but once the meal is over, you have to call cabin crew if you want a drink. Snacks would be a good idea too. This is the first time flying for me where the hasn't been the option of purchasing refreshments. Other than that it was a positive experience and I would happily fly with them again, but would know to bring my own drinks/snacks.
reviews.author: Estelle R

reviews.title: Mrs.
reviews.text: Lost two days of my holiday due to both my flights being cancelled & my day at The Melbourne cup No communication whatsoever from airline staff. Information relayed by other traveller. Never ever fly with this airline again Return flight Dec 4th delayed 2.30 hours at Melbourne & 2.10 at Brunei
reviews.author: Gabriel G

reviews.title: Awful
reviews.text: Terrible experience - avoid at all costs. I won’t fly with Royal Brunei again. My flights were moved at short notice leaving me a >24 hr stopover in Brunei and getting me home a day late, and both legs were then delayed by more than 2 hours each. An additional (and unannounced) stop in Dubai was added, at which we were all required to disembark and go back through security - essentially adding another changeover. In each case - no comms, no apology, no compensation, no support, no offer of refreshment, accommodation etc
reviews.author: bachallis

reviews.title: Do not travel with royal Brunei
reviews.text: Absolutely appalling company. Do not travel. Our flight was cancelled 5 days before departure. The extra leg room flights we paid £300 for were not given to us. The flight in total was over 3 hours delayed. I have sent 5 emails to customer care. 3 weeks later I have yet to receive any response at all. There's no way to seek compensation or an apology. The fairs were cheaper but there's a reason for that. Would never fly again and wouldn't recommend flying with them.
reviews.author: Jenny

reviews.title: NOT BABY FRIENDLY
reviews.text: If you want a kind, helpful, caring airline when travelling with children then I suggest you look elsewhere. Firstly you have to pay a huge amount to have a bassinet seat. Secondly, LHR RBA didn't let families board first. If you call customer care in London (like I did for 3 weeks to book a bassinet seat) then you are put on hold and then it cuts you off saying they are too busy. The only way I got a paid for bassinet seat was by having a family member GO IN to an office in Bandar. Ludicrous. Travelling with a baby makes you a passenger with high needs for support and I felt totally abandoned especially as I was travelling alone. Talking to ex RBA staff I know in Bandar, they were shocked and mortified that you are not automatically given a bassinet anymore or extra help from RBA. The aim for a bassinet seat is to help the parent and child PLUS help reduce stress and disruption to other passengers. It should therefore be automatic to assign these seats to mothers etc instead of focusing on money making. Note: onboard staff were kind and there were no issues there. They got the bassinet ready as soon as they could after takeoff.
reviews.author: Emily W

reviews.title: Complete lack of customer service
reviews.text: Booked a business flight London- melbourne for December with a 2 hr stopover in Brunei. They have now informed me that this flight is cancelled and flight will go via Dubai AND Brunei with a 7 hour layover. Tried to complain by phone (1 hr wait,) and was told if I didn't like it i could cancel! Trying to reschedule business class costs over £8000 at his late stage. I have written a complaint 3 weeks ago and heard nothing. I booked the original flight because It was a 1-stop flight with a 2 hour layover. Its now a 2 stop flight with 7 hours layover. I have medical conditons and this is not OK. Being told my only option is to accept this new flight or cancel is unacceptable. this is NOT what i booked and paid for.customer service - non existent. Do not fly with them, they can do anything they like once you've paid.
reviews.author: Tabby46

reviews.title: Worst airline
reviews.text: Booked and paid for flights to Dubai in December 2022. Received confirmation. Unfortunately, 2 months prior to the trip they changed all the dates and times of the flights such that all connecting flights leave a full day before we can catch them. My partner and I have tried to contact the airlines to no avail. We have been put on hold for up to 1h30m and transferred through every department (none of them seem to be able to process a full refund of flexible, insured tickets, so we can purchase tickets with another airline). We attempted going through webjet as well. We have been offered credit with the same airline through webjet - which we obviously do not want. Cheaper is not always better. Please book with reputable airlines, because inconvenience costs.
reviews.author: Wachizya N

reviews.title: Don’t know how they win awards !
reviews.text: Fly several times a year. Ground staff @ Heathrow ignorant & unhelpful, that’s if they show up, for connecting flights transits. Aircraft are filthy & old. RBA customer service non existent. Take money & leave you in limbo. Upgrade joke, I have over 100,000 air miles can only upgrade Brunei-London. Excess baggage charges are astronomical. £115 for 5kg. This airline is overpriced & under classed ! So happy other airlines now active
reviews.author: Bothybot

reviews.title: My lost luggage
reviews.text: It’s more than a month I have arrived in Melbourne, my luggage missing in Dubai . No one getting back to me . Poor customer service!! They are not replying to emails nor telephones!!!!!
reviews.author: nasrin h

reviews.title: Alcohol prohibited
reviews.text: Not recommended in my experience to anyone. I bought drinks from duty free shops in Dubai to Australia. We have checked in in Dubai there is no issues for less than 2 litres alcohol for transferring passengers. Always you will be surprised by double standard rouls from not trusted airlines. In Burnai airport they took my drinks and said we signed an agreement with Australian government to not allow people to take alcohol to Australia.
reviews.author: alireza n

reviews.title: Dubai - Auckland ( NZ) , Missing Baggage
reviews.text: I booked Dubai - Auckland Flight of 17th August 2022 for me and family , The baggage were checked in at Dubai until Auckland . Terrible experience as all my baggage were missing up on reaching at Auckland air port ( on 18th ). Completely traumatized situation as i am still chasing as there is a little or no response from RB .
reviews.author: Jiby C

reviews.title: v difficult to talk to agents here...  it's all circular kind of talk !!
reviews.text: sometimes the agent can b v helpful & will guide u through ur booking well . other times they put u on hold for sooo long. when u talk to them, there's jsut this roundabout way of respondign to ur questions! soo painful.
reviews.author: yuesefen2001

reviews.title: Last minute shocking experience
reviews.text: I had a flight from Dubai to Melbourne on July 29. The hospitality of cabin crew of the airline was great despite of not alcoholic drinks service which was fine because of the Islamic country rules. When it came to reclaim the lugguges, I was shocked because the luggage was totally wrecked and broken but I couldn't find any one to claim and talk to.
reviews.author: Mehrdad D

reviews.title: Royal Brunei terrible customer service
reviews.text: I made the online checkin and for some reason the app doesn't generate the pass code, I'm not allowed to get into the International sector of Dubai airport, also, the agents at the airport Brunei spot refuse to help before 3 hours of my flight, what means I'm stuck outside for 20 hours. Tried to call customer service in Australia, no one working on Sunday, Tried the internacional number, 2 hours on the phone and no answer yet. Its a nightmare and I'll take this into a court as soon I'm at home.
reviews.author: Luiz Igor R

reviews.title: AVOID! Please do not fly with Royal Brunei Airlines
reviews.text: One of the worst airlines. Very unprofessional staff. They have bought a few aircrafts and are trying to call them an international airline! 1. Customer support is NON-existent. We booked through an agent in Australia and even they were very frustrated. We were unable to upgrade to business and were willing to pay the fee. None of the staff knew what to do. 2. The crew including the pilot did not arrive on time in Melbourne as "no one picked the crew from their hotel" and our flight was delayed. 3. Everything at the tiny airport was closed except a few toilets. We had the "Sky Lounge" booking which was below the standard of a business class lounge. It was overpriced. 4. On the way back our flight was changed and flying around 12 hours earlier from London. Leaving us with 10.5 hours transit. The airline refused to provide a hotel for change of flight. 5. We had plenty of miles and were unable to use them to book the so called "Sky Lounge". They purposely disabled it so people cannot use it, however they want us to pay for the Lounge. 6. Everyone at the airline keeps referring to some ghosts at the airline who control the airline and make decisions. Its very unprofessional as no one takes responsibility. 7. The seats at the aircraft are average or below average. Very poor airline service.
reviews.author: I N

reviews.title: Great customer service!
reviews.text: London Heathrow airport is completely understaffed at the moment, meaning that even though people arrived at the airport on time to check in, they couldn't process all passengers in time for a scheduled delay. (Not a Royal Brunei issue - specifically a Heathrow staffing issue). My two next flights were missed due to delays and when I arrived at the second flight I had found that Royal Brunei had already rebooked me on another connecting flight (with a completely unrelated, but very good, top tier airline) and ensured that I didn't have to do anything at all and I would make my final destination with no trouble. I really appreciated the fact that they did this all without me having to ask and organised efficient re-connections for me, even though I wasn't initially flying with them for my third flight. Beyond impressed! Really great service on board also. Side note - have flown Royal Brunei before also and had excellent customer service then too! Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Milanka N

reviews.title: First time travel, little regard of covid protocols
reviews.text: There was no mask enforcement. Hardly anyone wearing a mask. No sanitizer/ hand towels/ etc provided even with meals. Very poor hygeine consideration particular to covid. Interestingly, while landing passengers were advised to put on their masks while in the airport after a 16 hour flight without masks. :D Some flight attendants touching their loosely fitted masks before handing out refreshments.
reviews.author: Shreya

reviews.title: Flight cancelled by airline and deduction of 50BND for refund
reviews.text: I cannot begin to describe the terrible customer service provided by Royal Brunei. I received an automated email from Royal Brunei that part of my return flight circuit had been rescheduled resulting in a messy itinerary whereby I was departing Melbourne on 6th August and had to catch the next connecting flight on the 5th August! Huh!!!! How does that work? Obviously i tried contacting the airline at local number without success and when I tried calling and reached the call center at Bandar Seri Bagwan, the line disconnected 3 times as soon as I read out the reservation number. Next option I tried filling out the online form and this did not work either. The local center also did not answer my call. I feel totally helpless and don't understand how this airline can even operate? Close to $7000 of my ticket's worth is tied up with this airline, and I would be very happy to get a refund however, I am not sure if it will ever happen.
reviews.author: Hamzaali

reviews.title: Won’t issue full refund
reviews.text: Terrible customer service. They cancelled my flight and automatically re-booked my ticket for a different date. I asked for a refund because I could not travel on the date they had selected. They charged me an $80 cancellation fee (for a flight I had never agreed to). I asked to speak with a manager to discuss the $80 cancellation fee and was told none were available.
reviews.author: Luke J

reviews.title: poor choice of Food/entertainment/bevergaes
reviews.text: Having flown RBA a few times and been disappointed, I was hoping my next flight would be better but again I was let down. The food is awful and the beverages are no good. The entertainment system is very poor and my extendable TV didn't even stay up and kept smashing my knee for during my 14hr journey which was very unpleasant. The bathrooms aren't cleaned during the flight and where in a terrible state towards the end. It will be the last time I fly with RBA unfortunately. Also I felt like I was annoying the staff every time I asked for a drink.
reviews.author: Jonathan smith

reviews.title: Royal Brunei has terrible customer service and totally ignores complaints about it
reviews.text: We flew to Brisbane to see our family with RBA on the 9th March 2020 we were due to return with a two night stopover in Bandar Seri Begawan on the 8th April. Because I have very long legs we had also paid for extra legroom for all the sections of the journey.. On the 18th March in response to Govt advice that we should return to UK we telephoned the Royal Brunei office in Melbourne. We were then told that we could rebook our flight for the 21st March 2020 On Saturday the 21st just as we were leaving for the airport received an e mail stating that “your flights are cancelled”.We checked on the airport and airline web sites both of which said that the flight was taking place. For a number of reasons we concluded that this was an attempt to defraud us and had been sent by someone who had hacked into the airline and had got details of the booking and in the circumstances of the current crisis was attempting to panic us into buying new tickets. The reasons we thought this was a scam was that it stated departure 1st March We arrived at the airport and attempted to check in and were told that we could not travel. The grounds were quite preposterous, that we had not been away from London for more than 14 days. We had already had one stopover in Brunei on the outward flight and were not given any reason why we were suddenly a higher risk. It was bad enough having to cut the time of our holiday with our family in half .We were obviously devastated by the news that we could not travel and asked what our options were, we were told that we could fly to Brunei from Melbourne in two days time but there were no onward connections to London. So this offer was clearly worse than useless.We understood that airlines are required to rebook if flights that are cancelled. In its recent post crisis information document Royal Brunei states: Our Commitment "We will do all we can to help support our guests at this time" . We asked if in the light of this we would be rebooked with another carrier, this was refused . The sum total of this 'support' was to point to a travel agent where we could buy another ticket. We were not offered even minor support such as a meal voucher access to a lounge or assistance with a journey from the airport. We were appalled by the total lack of support by Royal Brunei for our situation caused entirely by their arbitrary decision .We felt that in the circumstances with flights being cancelled daily we had no option but to rebook. As all the carriers were exploiting the situation we had to pay 5 times the original price for a later flight that day , We had enough money on our credit cards to do this, but as far as Royal Brunei were concerned if we had not been able to pay these prices we would have had to stay at the airport indefinitely . The airline was not concerned that we had to wait another 5 hours at the airport, hardly desirable for 'guests' in their mid 70s facing a 24 hour flight, We endure another long check in queue (my wife has a replacement knee and vertigo so this was not easy) and the fact that i was not able to get a seat with extra legroom and were denied our planned stopover made it a far less comfortable journey than expected. The delay also totally disrupted our travel arrangements when we arrived in London. By forcing us to travel via a much larger and more crowded hub Royal Brunei increased the risk of infection for two people in a vulnerable age group. The fact that we were transferred to a flight that the airline knew or should have known we could not travel on amounts to at best total incompetence and at worst deliberate fraud. We were told that the health restrictions were imposed on the 18th . Why were we not told we could not travel until we had left for the airport on the 21st When we complained to RBA we were told to obtain a refund via our travel agent .This we eventually did but it was of course a fraction of what we had paid for our return flights. We were offered no compensation for the way
reviews.author: macforge

reviews.title: DO NOT FLY WITH RB! SCAMMERS
reviews.text: Booked a flight and the flight got cancelled without any of my consent. When I asked them to give me a confirmation to when the next flight it’s going to be. They DEMANDED me to pay another +800BND additional just because they can’t keep their stuff together, not to mention their trashy management. I DO NOT RECOMMEND FLYING WITH RB.
reviews.author: RB HATER

reviews.title: My review of the airline without flying due to Covid-19
reviews.text: I was supposed to be heading to Japan from Melbourne in July, of which I had booked earlier in the year. With the whole Covid-19 situation and borders being locked, I sent an email to the RBA (Royal Brunei Airlines) team and received a call from an Amanda B in Queensland who advised me to look on the website closer to the date to see what will happen with the flight, etc. As the flight was cancelled, there were three options I could choose from; a refund, rebook for another date or accept a travel voucher (I believe two years validity) was the time frame. I contemplated my decision thoroughly with pros versus cons and talked with Amanda quite a few times about the whole situation of uncertainty. She was patient and advised that I could obtain a full refund (even though the website mentioned an admin fee as a charge). I'm happy to say that even though the wait time advised at first from Amanda was approximately 8 weeks, the email I received after submitting for refund advised 16 weeks. Sure enough, people pay straight away and they would expect to be refunded in a short span of time. I understand that many people didn't even get anything back with their flights and planned trips. So, I'm grateful that I could get my funds back. I told Amanda that I'd write a review. It's taken some time (more than a few months) but I wanted to keep my word. I also wanted to wait and see how long my refund would take. It didn't take 16 weeks at all. More precisely, it was just over two months. Unfortunately, I can't review on the experience I had flying as such, but I certainly can review the dealing and help I received from her and the team which was between very good and excellent. I'm giving a rating of 5 even though the time frame might be considered long, the whole process was straightforward. Thank you Amanda and the ticketing agent staff for completing my request. May we all be able to travel soon so the world can become our oyster once again.
reviews.author: Matty C

reviews.title: Flight refund for trip from London to Brisbane
reviews.text: My flight from London to Brisbane was not cancelled but I was refused transit as i had a British Passport and even though I could land in Brisbane I was not allowed to transit through Brunei at the time. I have been told that I have been given a refund but I have no bank record showing this and Royal Brunei say thet they do not have details of which bank and bank account it has gone to. It has now been eight months since I got back and emails that I now send are not even answered.
reviews.author: dom h

reviews.title: Refund due to covid cancellation
reviews.text: My wife and I were due to fly from UK to Melbourne for 6 week holiday at the beginning of April. The flight was understandably cancelled. !6 weeks later we are still to receive a refund as Royal Brunei have not yet refunded the agent , Travel Up.[or so they say.] Not sure who is to blame but Royal Brunei wont talk to us so they are guilty by association . Be very wary of booking with this airline, or using the agent TravelUp.
reviews.author: Rob H

reviews.title: Excellent service during the chaos of CV19
reviews.text: We are frequent business travellers and we were meant to travel in March during the craziness of CV19. But like everyone else we had to cancel last minute. Contacting RB was a breeze. We spoke to the staff in Brunei and in Brisbane (Amanda) and nothing was a problem. They were all helpful and answered promptly our emails and phone calls. And we received a full refund without hesitation. And Amanda followed up late to check if all was ok. We fly business most times and I would more than happy to rebook with RB again as soon as the restrictions are lifted.
reviews.author: Trippingaround2016

reviews.title: Prompt refund
reviews.text: The tickets for our trip to the UK were booked directly through the Royal Brunei Airlines website, as we have previously done on several occasions. Unfortunately travel was not possible due to SARS-CoV-2 and we were contacted by ‘phone by Amanda from Royal Brunei Airlines to let us know that our flights were cancelled. Amanda explained our options and in a subsequent email sent the URL for the refund request form. We completed the form and have recently received our refund. We have always had very good service on our dealings and flights with Royal Brunei Airlines, and we will certainly look to fly with them in the future.
reviews.author: Atholl
